baseline_definition: copy_current predicts the unchanged latest observation. kinematic uses the executed cardinal action, adjacent wall bits and declared grid size: move by 1/(size-1) only when unblocked, set heading to that action, keep goal coordinates and recompute goal displacement, advance episode clock by 1/256, predict nonterminal reward -0.1 for collision or -0.01 otherwise, and retain progress/constant features. Adjacent walls are copied because newly visible walls are unknown. Terminal transitions, including goal changes and episode resets, are excluded from every predictor and baseline score.
